content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Reno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review PMI's official guidelines to confirm your background qualifies, then gather documentation of your work history and formal education to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions synchronously with experienced instructors, interact with peers, and earn the formal education hours PMI requires before you can apply for the credential.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application directly with PMI, providing proof of your education, work experience, and boot camp completion. Pay PMI's examination fee to activate your application and secure your eligibility to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, review materials, and guidance—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the computer-based assessment at your chosen testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout your three-year certification cycle by attending training, conferences, or professional activities. Submit your PDU record to PMI before your renewal deadline to maintain your active PMP status.
